general.title: General
general.devModeDesc: Enables verbose logs and DevTools shortcuts.
general.freeTierDesc: Cap identities to 3 (matches Free plan). Useful for marketing screenshots.
general.logLevelDesc: DEBUG is verbose; WARN/ERROR for production.
general.languageDesc: UI language. Auto uses your Mac's system language.

automation.title: Automation (MCP server)
automation.enableDesc: Exposes the OZ MCP API on localhost so external agents (Claude Cowork, Cursor, Claude Code) can drive the browser. Off by default for security.
automation.tokenDesc: If set, MCP requests must include this token.
automation.coworkDesc: Copy this snippet, then paste it into your Claude Desktop config file. OZ tools will appear in every Cowork session.

migration.title: Migration — Ghost Browser
migration.intro: Import identities, workspaces, cookies, and saved passwords from Ghost Browser. macOS will prompt for Keychain access the first time — click Always Allow so future runs do not ask again.
migration.notFound: Ghost Browser is not installed in the standard location.
migration.importingDesc: macOS may show a Keychain dialog asking for access to "Ghost Browser Safe Storage". Click Always Allow.
migration.modeMergeDesc: Skip Ghost identities and workspaces already imported. Only adds new items from Ghost.
migration.modeReplaceDescAfter: imported previously from Ghost, then re-import fresh. Existing OZ identities/workspaces unrelated to Ghost are untouched.
migration.replaceConfirm:
This will DELETE the identities and workspaces from your previous Ghost import, then re-import them fresh.

Existing OZ identities/workspaces that were NOT imported from Ghost are not affected.

Continue?

about.title: About OZ Browser
about.subtitle: Identities · Workspaces · Vault · Proxies · FingerprintEngine
about.description: Multi-session Chromium browser based on Electron. Anti-detect via per-identity fingerprint spoofing (11 vectors).
about.autoUpdateDesc: When enabled, OZ checks GitHub Releases every 4 hours and downloads new versions in the background. You'll see a notification when an update is ready to install.
about.statusReady: Update v{{version}} ready — click Restart and install.

proxyDashboard.actionsNote: Live ops view. Actions apply immediately. Edit modal arrives in v1.1.3.

identities.title: Identities
identities.tagline: Each identity is a fully isolated browser session — its own cookies, storage, login state, and extensions.
identities.defaultDesc: — your main session, ships with Chrome Web Store extensions enabled.
identities.customDesc: — one per persona / account. Switch from the sidebar; tabs remember which identity they belong to.
identities.colorDesc: on every tab so you never confuse them.

workspaces.title: Workspaces & Vault
workspaces.tagline: Workspaces group sessions per project; the encrypted vault stores credentials safely on your Mac.
workspaces.groupsDesc: — Excel-like grouping. Switch to snapshot the current set of tabs and load a different one.
workspaces.vaultDesc: — AES-256-GCM encrypted account store. Master key in Keychain. Auto-fill on login pages.
workspaces.timeMachineDesc: — daily encrypted snapshots of your entire setup. Restore any time.

antidetect.title: Proxies, Fingerprint & Automation
antidetect.tagline: Antidetect that goes beyond Ghost Browser: per-identity fingerprint + GeoIP coherence + headless automation.
antidetect.proxiesDesc: — assign per-identity / workspace. Auto-disable on health failure. Oxylabs sticky-session template built-in.
antidetect.fingerprintDesc: — 11 vectors spoofed consistently per identity (UA, screen, timezone, canvas, WebGL).
antidetect.mcpDesc: — control OZ from any LLM agent. Toggle on in Settings → Automation.

step1.title: Step 1 — Create a workspace
step1.tagline: Workspaces group identities per project. Name it after the project or client.

step2.title: Step 2 — Add proxies
step2.hint: Tip: skip this step if you already have proxies configured — you can add more from the Proxy Dashboard later.
step2.errZeroValid: 0 valid proxies ({{n}} invalid). Fix and retry.

step3.title: Step 3 — Create identities
step3.tagline: Each identity is a fully isolated session (cookies, storage, login). Common: 1 per social media account.
step3.previewHint: Identities will be named "{{prefix}} 1", "{{prefix}} 2", … and live inside {{workspace}}.
step3.errNoWorkspace: No workspace created — go back to step 1.

step4.title: Step 4 — Pair proxies to identities
step4.tagline: 1:1 mapping — each identity gets its own proxy.
step4.nothingToPair: Nothing to pair. You can skip this step and assign later from the Proxy Dashboard.

step5.title: Step 5 — Test the setup
step5.tagline: We'll ping all assigned proxies and confirm they're reachable.
step5.hint: Click Finish below to run the tests. This takes 5–30s depending on proxy count.
step5.doneIssues: Some proxies failed — check the Proxy Dashboard to inspect. They are auto-disabled after 3 failures.
step5.doneOk: All systems green. You can start opening tabs in your new identities from the sidebar.

accountManager.title: Account Manager

lock.title: Vault is locked
lock.desc: Unlock the vault to access your saved accounts. The master key is stored in your macOS Keychain — you may be prompted to allow access.
lock.setupDesc: On first unlock, OZ generates a 256-bit master key, stores it in your macOS Keychain, and creates an empty vault. Click Unlock to begin — you may see a Keychain prompt.

list.empty: No accounts match the current filters.

import.filenameIntro: Importing from {{filename}}. Choose how to merge into your vault:
import.modeMergePermDesc: Update accounts matched by identity+site+username, add the rest. Identities and workspaces missing in the vault are auto-created.
import.modeNewWsDesc: Put all imported accounts into a new dedicated workspace named "Imported YYYY-MM-DD". Existing data untouched.
import.modeEphemeralDesc: Don't persist anything — only show the parsed rows in this session. Useful for one-shot logins (external client, etc.).
import.modeOverwriteDesc: REPLACE the entire vault with the file's contents. Make a Time Machine snapshot first — this is destructive.
import.confirmOverwriteTotal:
⚠ OVERWRITE TOTAL

This REPLACES the entire vault with the contents of the Excel file. Existing accounts will be permanently lost unless you have a backup.

Make sure Time Machine has a recent snapshot. Proceed?

errors.vaultStatus: Failed to read vault status. Check the log.

confirms.destroyVault:
DESTROY the vault?

This deletes the encrypted file AND removes the master key from Keychain. Old accounts become unrecoverable. The next unlock will start a fresh, empty vault.

This cannot be undone.

team.title: 👥 Team

notConfigured.title: Team mode not configured
notConfigured.desc: This OZ build was packaged without the Dropbox app key. Team mode requires Dropbox to be set up first via Cloud Backup.

standalone.title: You're operating in solo mode
standalone.descHtml:
Team mode lets you share your OZ vault with trusted teammates via their own Macs. Identities, workspaces and snapshots are end-to-end encrypted with Curve25519 key-sharing — your master key stays in the macOS Keychain on each device.

Prerequisite: connect Dropbox first (Cloud Backup), then share your /Apps/OZ Browser/ Dropbox folder with each teammate from your Dropbox web UI.

owner.metaLine: Team ID: {{teamId}} · You are the owner ({{myMemberId}})
owner.inviteDisplayDesc: Send this link to your teammate via Signal or other secure channel. Expires in 24h. They'll open it to start the join flow.

members.empty: No members yet. Share an invite to get started.
members.waitingForKey: ⏳ Waiting for owner to wrap key

team.confirmCreate: Create a new team using this OZ install as owner? You can invite members afterwards.
team.confirmJoin:
Joining a team REPLACES your current OZ data with the team owner's data.

A pre-join snapshot will be saved + your current master key archived
(recoverable later via Time Machine). Restart will be required.

Continue?
team.confirmLeave: Leave the team? Your local copy of the team master key remains so you can still access local snapshots, but you stop receiving updates.
team.confirmDisband: Disband the team? This deletes the team folder in Dropbox and all member access. Your local data stays. Continue?
team.confirmRemoveMember: Remove member {{memberId}} from team? They will lose access to new snapshots.
team.joinedAlert:
✓ Joined team.

Pre-join snapshot saved as {{preJoinSnapshotId}}.
Your previous OZ data was archived. Restart OZ Browser now so the new state takes effect.

cloudBackup.title: ☁ Cloud Backup (Dropbox)

disconnected.title: Connect Dropbox to enable cloud backup
disconnected.desc1: Time Machine snapshots are already encrypted on your Mac with AES-256-GCM. Connecting Dropbox uploads those encrypted files to your account — Dropbox never sees plaintext. Your master key stays in the macOS Keychain.
disconnected.desc2: Each Mac uploads to its own folder so multiple devices never collide. From any other device you can restore an older snapshot uploaded here.

cloudBackup.connectInfo: A browser tab opened for Dropbox authorization. Approve there, then come back.
cloudBackup.autoUploadDesc: Every daily, manual and pre-destructive snapshot uploads in the background. Pre-restore snapshots are skipped.
cloudBackup.devicesEmpty: No devices have uploaded snapshots yet. Take a snapshot to start.
cloudBackup.noRemoteSnapshots: No remote snapshots in this device folder.
cloudBackup.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Dropbox? Local snapshots stay safe; cloud copies will no longer be uploaded.
cloudBackup.confirmRestore:
Restore snapshot "{{id}}" from {{source}}?

This REPLACES your current accounts, identities, workspaces and browser sessions.

A safety snapshot of your CURRENT state will be created automatically. After restore you must restart OZ Browser. Continue?

identityEditor.uaHintHtml: Sets the HTTP User-Agent header for this Identity's session. Does not yet override navigator.userAgent — full coherent fingerprint comes in Bloque 1.5. ADR 0010.
